description: Keeps the pinned world from fossilizing: docker tags, GitHub Action SHAs, npm lockfile, and the vcpkg baseline.

packageRules.description: Auto-merge patch updates when CI is green
Infra images (Postgres/Redis/Kafka) — majors need a human
GitHub Actions minors auto-merge after a week of soak
npm devDependencies minors auto-merge after a week of soak

swagger-ui-dist CDN pin carries sha384 SRI hashes Renovate cannot recompute — a bump without a re-pin ships a /docs page the browser refuses to load. Never automerge; human re-pins per the comment at the pin (src/api/Middleware.cpp), nightly swagger-sri-guard catches drift
vcpkg baseline bump rebuilds the whole dependency world — never automerge (must stay last: later rules win)

customManagers.description: vcpkg builtin-baseline (vcpkg.json) and the matching VCPKG_REF arg in docker/Dockerfile track microsoft/vcpkg master

swagger-ui-dist version pinned in the Swagger UI HTML served by src/api/Middleware.cpp (unpkg URLs + provenance comment — every @x.y.z occurrence is bumped together). Visibility only: the paired sha384 SRI hashes must be recomputed by hand on every bump
